chains.source: E01 design §4.7.1: the total capital investment is the sum of the bare-module costs

PrISMa SI §6.3.3 (CC BY), after the EBTF method; docs/briefs/PrISMa-scoping.md:115. TDC is the sum of bare-module costs (LM as each item's F_BM); EPC = 1.10·1.14·1.30·TDC; CAPEX = 1.07·EPC. PrISMa's IDC/TCR step is the PrISMa package's to add.
